name: Umbral Patio
motion: The handle turns 180°, the moving panels lift 6 mm onto their rollers, glide and stack over the fixed panel, then return and settle; 10 s clip Panels_LiftSlide_<size>, and a handle-only lift clip.
options: Glass: Claro / Gris / Bronce / Satinado / Acanalado
Divided lites: Clear view / Grid / Perimeter
Handle: Fixed handle with key / Flush lever

hotspots.title: Turn the handle
hotspots.text: A 180° turn lifts the panel 6 mm onto its rollers. Turn it back and it settles onto the seals and locks.

hotspots.title: Lift, slide, stack
hotspots.text: The moving panels lift, glide and stack over the fixed one. Each runs on its own track, 97.5 mm apart.

hotspots.title: Timber inside
hotspots.text: The inside face is timber: Roble Ahumado or Nogal, or painted Piedra or Negro Carbón.

hotspots.title: Aluminium outside
hotspots.text: The outside face is 22 mm of extruded aluminium that takes the weather. Its finish is chosen separately from the timber.

hotspots.title: 24 mm insulating glass
hotspots.text: Two 5 mm panes around a 14 mm cavity. Claro, Gris, Bronce, Satinado or Acanalado under Glass.

hotspots.title: Near-level threshold
hotspots.text: The sill sits in a slot in the floor, so only 5 mm of track shows above it.

description: A lift-and-slide door, timber inside and aluminium outside. A half turn of the handle lifts each panel 6 mm onto its rollers; it glides, stacks and settles back onto its seals.
gaps: sightline_mm = two 102 mm meeting stiles less their 55 mm overlap; frame_depth_mm is the 3-panel jamb (4-panel: 368 mm).
Interior timber is a retint of the source oak/mahogany textures, not a new grain scan.
Material names carry the product (account-unique names).
Stills are Cycles renders of the source .blend with stills-only floor/wall extensions; the GLB itself is unchanged apart from renamed internal node and image names.
qa: Live QA 25 Nov: loads with Roble Ahumado inside and Bronce Umbra outside, 6 hotspots; "Lift, slide, stack" stacks both moving panels over the fixed one.
